name: Wicked Garden
description:
Wicked Garden — AI-Native SDLC

A full software development lifecycle as a single Claude Code plugin. 14 domains, 80 specialist agents, 152 commands — covering everything from requirements through production operations.

What makes it different from a good CLAUDE.md: it's executable infrastructure, not passive guidance. Hooks enforce workflow gates before Claude sees your prompt. Context from memory, search, and project state is assembled automatically on
every turn. Decisions persist across sessions. Quality gates actually block progression when evidence is missing.

Works standalone with zero external dependencies. Local SQLite storage. No API keys, no cloud services, no setup beyond install.

Core systems:

- Crew — Signal-driven project workflows with 8 phases (clarify → design → build → test → review → operate), 7-dimension complexity scoring, hard-enforced quality gates, and multi-perspective consensus review for high-stakes decisions
- Smaht — Automatic context assembly on every prompt via 3-tier routing (hot/fast/slow). Surfaces relevant memories, code search results, kanban state, and crew context without you asking
- Mem — 3-tier persistent memory (working → episodic → semantic) with auto-consolidation, tag-based search, and access-frequency ranking. Decisions from month-old sessions surface when relevant
- Search — Code intelligence with symbol search, blast radius analysis, data lineage tracing, and service map discovery
- Jam — AI brainstorming with dynamic persona focus groups and multi-model council sessions using installed LLM CLIs (Codex, Gemini, Copilot)

Plus specialist agents for engineering, product, platform/DevSecOps, QE, data, delivery, agentic architecture, and on-demand personas.
longDescription:
Ships **10 skills**, **11 agents**, **6 commands** and **12 hooks**.

- **Skills** (10): `deliberate` (Critical thinking framework applied before doing work), `integration-discovery` (Capability router that decides which tools, skills, and agents to use for a task), `jam` (Orchestrates AI-powered brainstorming sessions with dynamic focus groups), `kanban` (Persistent task management through kanban boards with cross-session tracking), `mem` (Memory storage, recall, and lifecycle management for maintaining context across sessions), `multi-model` (Multi-model AI collaboration: discover installed LLM CLIs and orchestrate council sessions, cross-model reviews, and diverse perspective gathering), `persona` (On-demand persona invocation system for applying named perspectives to any task), `runtime-exec` (Smart runtime execution for Python and Node scripts with automatic package manager detection), and 2 more
- **Agents** (11): `agentic`, `crew`, `data`, `delivery`, `engineering`, `jam`, `mem`, `persona`, and 3 more
- **Commands** (6): `aliases` (Backward compatibility aliases for old multi-plugin command names), `deliberate` (Critically analyze any work request before implementation — challenge assumptions, find root causes, identify opportunities, and propose better…), `help` (Show available agentic architecture commands and usage), `report-issue` (File a GitHub issue for a bug, UX friction point, or unmet outcome), `reset` (Reset wicked-garden to a clean state — choose which data to clear), `setup` (Configure delivery metrics — cost model, commentary sensitivity, and sprint cadence)
- **Hooks** (12): `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `TaskCompleted`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, and 4 more

Installs with `claude plugin install wicked-garden@claude-community` from `mikeparcewski/wicked-garden`.
